title: NeuTral Rewriter: A Rule-Based and Neural Approach to Automatic Rewriting into Gender-Neutral Alternatives

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of rule-based and neural rewriting models in converting binary gendered text (e.g., pronouns, gender-marked job titles) into gender-neutral alternatives. The evaluation uses Word Error Rate (WER) and manual error analysis (e.g., subject-verb agreement, POS tagging errors) on synthetic (WinoBias+) and natural datasets (Reddit, OpenSubtitles).
